recent: 并更换公司秘书及注册地址。公司同时发布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度的业绩，以及截至 2025 年 8 月 31 日止年度的经审核财务报表。

recent_en: VTC proposed multiple corporate exercises in November 2026 and changed its company secretaries and registered address. It also released quarterly results for the period ended 31 Aug 2026 and audited financial statements for the year ended 31 Aug 2025.
notable_en: The company announced multiple proposals on 13 Nov 2026 and 2 Nov 2026.
The company changed its company secretaries, involving LIM KUI SUANG, TAN AI NING, TAI YIT CHAN and NG SHU LING.
The company changed its registered address.
